requiredFindings.title: Item 5 still describes the withdrawn finish reconciliation
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 5 tells an implementer of CommitUndetermined that finish reconciles under the lease and copies the floor only on OK, REVERT or ADVANCE. CommitUndetermined is the uncertain outcome. X3d r6 item 7 says that after an uncertain journal, attempt-admission, or evidence COMMIT, finish appends nothing, does not reopen the carrier, does not run reconcile_witness, copies no floor, and releases the lease; the next writer reconciles. X3d r6's header assigns that correction to X7's next revision and gives the replacement sentence. r4 edited this paragraph to disclose the namespace id and left the parenthetical in place. An implementer who follows it reconciles or copies a floor under the lease after an uncertain outcome, which the closed attempt ledger refuses and which X3d forbids. Required: replace the parenthetical with X3d r6's sentence, finish appends nothing and copies no floor; the next writer reconciles. Keep the rule that finalization never calls recover in the same invocation, and keep the r4 namespace disclosure. Item 6's certain-path REV and CLN append on an open ledger stays as written.

scope: Law X7 r4. Item 4's in-memory PublishedCommit meets owner §6.2 for M2 required delivery. RF-1: item 5 still describes the r4 finish reconciliation that X3d r6 withdrew. No product cargo.
